name: totp_generate
description: Generate and verify one-time passwords: TOTP (RFC 6238) for a time given in the input and HOTP (RFC 4226) for a counter, from a secret in base32 (as in authenticator apps), hex or ascii, with SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512, 6 to 8 digits, any period and epoch. Verification accepts a window of steps and reports the matching offset. The clock is never read and the secret is never echoed.

time.description: TOTP: Unix seconds or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (required for totp)

period.description: TOTP time step X in seconds

t0.description: TOTP epoch T0 in Unix seconds

window.description: Steps or counters accepted on each side when verifying

catalog.source: RFC 4226 (HOTP, dynamic truncation, section 5.3) and RFC 6238 (TOTP); base32 per RFC 4648 section 6
